---
title: Tables
---

Tables should survive the roundtrip. Lots of padding content first so Defuddle
doesn't classify this body as boilerplate — its content extractor drops short
pages aggressively.

This is a blog post about data tables. Tables are a legitimate part of web
content — pricing grids, comparisons, schedules, specs. Every modern feed
reader renders HTML tables correctly, so they belong in the allowlist.

## Pipe table

| Fruit  | Count | Notes  |
| ------ | ----- | ------ |
| Apple  | 12    | red    |
| Banana | 3     | yellow |
| Cherry | 100   | many   |

## HTML table with spans

<table>
  <caption>Shifts</caption>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">Day</th>
      <th scope="col" colspan="2">
        Hours
      </th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <th scope="row" rowspan="2">
        Mon
      </th>
      <td>9–12</td>
      <td>13–17</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>18–20</td>
      <td>21–23</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Trailing paragraph so Defuddle's heuristics have more weight on the main body
than on the table itself.
